replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
It looks like you have a good start, however I would make the map bigger. Expanding the main islands or adding more islands would make the map much better and capable of holding more players. Also, the middle island seems tiny and is unnecessary in my opinion.

Furthermore, while the stone brick looks good, it's rather overused throughout the maps and I generally like a bit of variety. Perhaps changing the block palette (quartz, brick, other fancy things) would make the map pop and be unique.

Overall I think with a bit of improvement this map could be really good!
